evals.prompt: We need a way for users to reset their passwords when they forget them. The app is a FastAPI web app with Pydantic models and an in-memory user store. What should we build? Assume you've asked all necessary clarifying questions and I've answered them.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs a design brainstorm: compares multiple solution metaphors with explicit trade-offs, justifies a selection with reasoning, and outputs a structured task list.
expectations: Multiple solution metaphors compared before selecting one

evals.prompt: Let me add dark mode toggle. Just a CSS change. What do you think?
evals.expected_output: Agent frames the problem before jumping to a solution, challenges or probes the user's premature 'just a CSS change' framing, surfaces related concerns (e.g. persistence, contrast), and captures open questions or assumptions to validate.
expectations: Problem framed before jumping to solution
User's premature solution challenged or probed
Alternatives or related concerns surfaced (e.g. persistence, contrast)
Scope of problem understood before design decisions
Output includes open questions or assumptions to validate

evals.prompt: We need a way for users to reset their passwords when they forget them. The app is a FastAPI web app with Pydantic models and an in-memory user store. Brainstorm the design, ask whatever clarifying questions you need, then produce the PRD as a standalone artifact in the workspace this session can hand to a plan-writer later. Assume I've answered your questions.
evals.expected_output: The agent conceives the design, then writes a standalone PRD document (not just an in-conversation reply) whose decisions are tied back to numbered user stories with rationale.
expectations: Standalone PRD artifact produced (design decisions captured in a document, not only in the chat reply)
User stories are numbered US-N sequentially in the order written
Each decision references one or more story IDs that exist in the user stories
Decisions carry a why/rationale line (chosen path, rejected alternative, or trade-off)
PRD section list equals problem statement, solution, user stories, implementation decisions, testing decisions, out of scope, further notes
